_comment: Display-only ticker -> disclosed-ownership/leadership affiliation map, surfaced on the news screen's idiosyncratic-catalyst section. This is NOT scored (never read by advisor_engine.py or scorer.py) and never asserts a political judgment on its own - it only echoes facts the maintainer has entered here, each with a verifiable source_url (an SEC filing, a company proxy statement, or a named news report). Add an entry only when the relationship is publicly disclosed and sourced; do not add a name based on rumor or inference. Matching is by ticker only (not text search), so a listed name shows up on every news item for that ticker.
